title: Task exposure is not a workforce forecast
text: Evans argues that jobs and the markets around them can change when a task becomes cheaper: demand, adjacent activities and business models also respond. This is a reason to discuss work redesign honestly without promising either that no roles will change or that a task-level capability implies a specific headcount reduction.
qualification: Industry analysis represented in supplied notes; it does not forecast net employment or settle which roles will grow.
